meta.title: 被问四年不晋升？跳出坑再回答
meta.title_en: Asked Why No Promotion in 4 Years? Pivot Out of the Trap

scenes.context: 讲者设定场景：上一份工作四五年没升职，面试官质疑为什么这么久没晋升。
sentences: 如果你上一份工作干了四五年一直没有升职。
Imagine you worked four or five years at your last job without a single promotion.
干了四五年：worked four or five years
面试的时候被面试官质疑：你为什么这么久没有晋升？
During the interview, the interviewer challenges you: why no promotion in all this time?
被质疑：get challenged
这是一个典型的压力面试题。
This is a classic stress interview question.
压力面试：stress interview
paraphrase: 提问带预设 → 先识别题型
The question carries a presumption—spot the trap first.
压力题考的不是答案，是应变
Stress questions test how you respond, not what you say.
scenes.speak: Imagine you worked four or five years at your last job without a single promotion. During the interview, the interviewer challenges you: why no promotion in all this time? This is a classic stress interview question.

scenes.title_en: The Real Trap the Interviewer Sets
scenes.context: 讲者点破面试官真正考的是能力还是追求的预设，顺着解释就会进坑。
sentences: 面试官真正的关注点是：没晋升是能力不行，还是对自己没追求。
What the interviewer really wants to know is whether it's lack of ability or lack of ambition.
真正的关注点：what they really want to know
如果说你顺着面试官的意思去解释，就把自己带到坑里去了。
If you answer within the interviewer's framing, you've walked straight into the trap.
带到坑里：walk into the trap
无论是能力不行还是没有追求，都默认了负面预设。
Whether you admit weakness or no ambition, you've accepted a negative assumption.
负面预设：negative assumption
paraphrase: 顺着解释 = 接受负面预设
Explaining along their lines means accepting a negative frame.
Spot the trap and refuse to play its game.
scenes.speak: What the interviewer really wants to know is whether it's lack of ability or lack of ambition. If you answer within the interviewer's framing, you've walked straight into the trap. Whether you admit weakness or no ambition, you've accepted a negative assumption.

scenes.title_en: Pivot Out: Answer from Your Own Angle
scenes.context: 讲者给出破法：跳出坑，从自己的角度、从三个维度回答，首讲行业经验与专业能力。
sentences: 要尽可能跳出这个坑，从自己的角度去回答面试官。
Pivot out of the trap and answer the interviewer from your own angle.
跳出坑：pivot out of the trap
从行业经验和专业能力上面，我这几年成长非常明显。
In terms of industry experience and expertise, I've grown a lot over these years.
专业能力：expertise
某些具体能力得到了充分锻炼，我认为这才是最实惠的。
Specific skills got sharpened through real practice—and I think that's what counts most.
得到充分锻炼：got sharpened through practice
paraphrase: 拒绝接招 → 从自己的维度回答
Refuse the framing and answer from your own dimensions.
没晋升 → 转成成长证据
Turn the lack of promotion into evidence of growth.
scenes.speak: Pivot out of the trap and answer the interviewer from your own angle. In terms of industry experience and expertise, I've grown a lot over these years. Specific skills got sharpened through real practice—and I think that's what counts most.

practice: 表达「没晋升但我成长了」
I didn't get a title change, but my skills grew a lot.
My core skills were sharpened through real practice.
I won't answer within that framing—let me share my own perspective.
I believe that's what matters most.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I didn't get promoted because the company didn't give me chances.
✓ 地道说法：I focused on growing my skills rather than chasing titles.
把责任转成自己的主动选择，避免抱怨公司。
✕ 直译腔：The interviewer's meaning is to test me.
✓ 地道说法：The interviewer is testing how I handle pressure.
✕ 直译腔：I fell into the pit.
✓ 地道说法：I walked straight into the trap.
进坑用 walk into the trap，不是 fell into the pit。
✕ 直译腔：The most practical thing is...
✓ 地道说法：That's what counts most.
最实惠用 what counts most 表达口语化。
shifts: 识别压力题，跳出预设框架
把没晋升变成成长叙事的入口
从面试官的质疑出发回答
从自己的角度、自己的维度回答
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「进深」按语境校正为「晋升」，「最实惠的」保留口语。视频只展开第一个维度，第二、三维度视频未继续，内容以现有转录为准。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
